name: FV_XLA_TRANSACTION_LINES
description: "This table contains the federal specific sources required during the federal subledger budgetary accounting of Purchasing, Payables, Costing, Receiving and Federal. This table  will be populated during subledger accounting  process."

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number of the event that needs to be processed

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger Identifier associated to the subledger accounting event

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Accounting event identifier.  Refers to the accounting event for which the data is extracted by federal SLA accounting hook

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application identifier of the accounting event

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Unique source document identifier

columns.name: SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Source doucment type, if it is PO or REQ or INVOICE etc

columns.name: SOURCE_DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Source document number for the event

columns.name: SOURCE_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document  line Identifier if any for the event

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Source document distribution Identifier if any for the event

columns.name: DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Source document budgetary control data set identifier.

columns.name: PRIOR_YEAR_FLAG
columns.description: Column to indicate if the transaction is result of a prior year transaction or not.

columns.name: TREASURY_SYMBOL_ID
columns.description: Treasury account symbol identifier associated to the transaction

columns.name: FUND_VALUE
columns.description: Fund value associated to the transaction

columns.name: APPORTIONMENT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Apportionment category code derived for the transaction fund

columns.name: DIRECT_OR_REIMBURSABLE_CODE
columns.description: Direct or reimbursable code derived for the transaction fund

columns.name: TAS_EXPIRED_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Treasury account symbol expiration status code

columns.name: PRIOR_YEAR_ADJUSTMENT_CODE
columns.description: Prior year adjustment type code. It is either UPWARD or DOWNWARD or Null.

columns.name: ENT_BUDGET_AMOUNT
columns.description: Entered un-anticipated budget amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ACC_BUDGET_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounted un-anticipated budget amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ENT_ANTICIPATED_RECOVERY_AMT
columns.description: Entered anticipated recovery amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ACC_ANTICIPATED_RECOVERY_AMT
columns.description: Accounted anticipated recovery amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ENT_COMMITMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Entered commitment amount  on the purchase requisition distribution derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ACC_COMMITMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounted commitment amount on the purchase requisition distribution derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ENT_UNPAID_OBLIG_AMOUNT
columns.description: Entered unpaid obligation amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ACC_UNPAID_OBLIG_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounted unpaid  purchase order obligation amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ENT_UNPAID_OBLIG_PYA_AMOUNT
columns.description: Entered unpaid  prior year account (PYA) amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ACC_UNPAID_OBLIG_PYA_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounted unpaid obligation prior year account amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ENT_UNPAID_OBLIG_PYA_OFF_AMT
columns.description: Entered unpaid obligation prior year account offset amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ACC_UNPAID_OBLIG_PYA_OFF_AMT
columns.description: Accounted unpaid obligation prior year account offset amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ENT_PAID_OBLIG_AMOUNT
columns.description: Entered paid obligation amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ACC_PAID_OBLIG_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounted paid obligation amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ENT_UNPAID_EXPEND_AMOUNT
columns.description: Entered unpaid expenditure amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ACC_UNPAID_EXPEND_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounted unpaid expenditure amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ENT_PAID_EXPEND_AMOUNT
columns.description: Entered paid expended  amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ACC_PAID_EXPEND_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounted paid expended  amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ENT_PAID_EXPEND_PYA_AMOUNT
columns.description: Entered paid expenditure prior year account amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ACC_PAID_EXPEND_PYA_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounted paid expenditure prior year account amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ENT_UNPAID_EXPEND_PYA_AMT
columns.description: Entered unpaid expenditure prior year account amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ACC_UNPAID_EXPEND_PYA_AMT
columns.description: Accounted unpaid expenditure prior year account amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ENT_UNPAID_EXPEND_PYA_OFF_AMT
columns.description: Entered unpaid expenditure prior year account offset amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ACC_UNPAID_EXPEND_PYA_OFF_AMT
columns.description: Accounted unpaid expenditure prior year account offset amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ENT_EXPENDED_APPROP_AMOUNT
columns.description: Entered expended appropriation amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ACC_EXPENDED_APPROP_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounted expended appropriation amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ENT_PAID_EXP_PYA_OFF_AMOUNT
columns.description: Entered paid expenditure prior year account offset amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: ACC_PAID_EXP_PYA_OFF_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounted paid expenditure prior year account offset amount derived for this source transaction

columns.name: FUNDING_DERIVATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Funding derivation type code. Value indicates whether the funding is derived from the general fund or not.

columns.name: ACC_APPROP_ACCRUED_AMT
columns.description: Accounted appropriations accrued ledger amount.

columns.name: ENT_APPROP_ACCRUED_AMT
columns.description: Entered appropriations accrued amount.

columns.name: ACC_APPROP_DISBURSED_AMT
columns.description: Accounted appropriations disbursed ledger amount.

columns.name: ENT_APPROP_DISBURSED_AMT
columns.description: Entered appropriations disbursed amount.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Purchase order distribution identifier

columns.name: PAYMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the federal payment type.

columns.name: PO_CO_BACKOUT_ENTERED_AMT
columns.description: PO change order backout entered amount.

columns.name: PO_CO_BACKOUT_ACCOUNTED_AMT
columns.description: PO change order backout accounted amount.

columns.name: PO_CO_BACKOUT_FLAG
columns.description: PO change order process backout indicator.

columns.name: PO_CO_BACKOUT_LINE_ID
columns.description: PO Change order reversal line identifier.
